_comment: Game-ready cold-open VO via Qwen3 Base-model clone of the picked per-mode VoiceDesign refs (refs_qwen/<char>_<mode>.wav). id -> sounds/dialog/prologue/<id>.wav once promoted; baked first to out/qwen3_clone/ for review.

lines.text: This is Scott. Slow down the evac — we're coming in too hot!
There's no time to explain — off to the side!
I haven't seen Rush. I don't know if he made it through.
Okay — hold your arm there, we'll get it in a sling.
This is my ship. We do this my way.
This ship could be the most important discovery mankind has ever made.
